values.note: Every RV site is full hookup at $41/night, the same on Tue 2026-11-03, Tue 2027-01-12, Tue 2027-06-15 and Sat 2027-06-19; CPW's fee table gives campsites $21-$41 (the low end is the walk-in tent sites). values.note: 57 full-hookup sites in five loops (Big Bear, Gobbler Grove, Raptor Glen, Swift Puma Heights, The Meadows; max vehicle lengths mostly 30-50 ft, up to 70 in The Meadows, many pull-throughs) and 10 walk-in tent sites, besides 2 cabins and the Turkey Roost group loop. CPW's camping page says 61 campsites.

sites.source: cpwshop.com parkID 50081 site list (co_sites_2026-10-12.jsonl: loop, type, maximum vehicle length) and per-site details (Driveway Entry) + https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/cheyenne-mountain-state-park/cheyenne-mountain-state-park-camping-lodging ('61 Campsites')

values.note: Camper services building with coin-operated showers, laundry and an activity room, April to November only (closed November to April); flush toilets in winter. Playground; firewood and ice sold.

facilities.source: https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/cheyenne-mountain-state-park/cheyenne-mountain-state-park-camping-lodging ('The camper services building offers coin operated showers, a laundry room and an activity room from April to November'; 'Our camper services building is closed from November to April each year'; 'Winter amenities: Flush toilets'; amenities list), read 2026-10-26

values.note: Reservation required, on cpwshop.com or 1-800-244-5613, up to six months ahead. Reservable all year, but 'Winter camping reservations are limited to the loop available.' 14 days in any 28; one camping unit and six people per site.

booking.source: https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/cheyenne-mountain-state-park/cheyenne-mountain-state-park-camping-lodging ('Reservations can be made online at cpwshop.com or by phone at 1-800-244-5613. Reservations can be made up to six months in advance'; 'A reservation is necessary'; 'The maximum stay is 14 days within a 28-day period'; 'Not all campsites are available during the winter months. Winter camping reservations are limited to the loop available.') + cpwshop Season Schedule (Peak Jan 1 - Dec 31, 2026 and 2027), read 2026-10-26

summary: Confirmed $41 full hookup (2026-27, same in winter), entrance via the vehicle pass. Added year-round season and reservable season, 50-amp full hookups, 67 sites (57 RV + 10 walk-in tent) to 70 ft with pull-throughs, showers/laundry (Apr-Nov) and flush toilets, reservation-only (fcfs never), 6-month window, 14 days per 28, cpwshop deep link.
